items.title: Anthropic Accuses Alibaba of ‘Illicitly’ Accessing Its Claude AI Models in Largest Known Distillation Attack
items.description: Anthropic has formally accused Chinese tech and e-commerce giant Alibaba of orchestrating a massive, unauthorized extraction campaign targeting its Claude AI model, marking what the company describes as the largest known distillation attack in its history.
